title: Some external websites give 'DNS_PROBE_FINISHED_NXDOMAIN'
description: Some news sites won't open in Chrome, but they open fine on the same connection on mobile.

worklogs.description: ipconfig /flushdns + cleared the browser DNS cache, the issue persisted.
Identified a bad-cached record on the internal resolver, manually purged it.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: There was bad cache on the internal resolver, I cleared it. You can try opening them again now.

resolutionNote: Cleared corrupted cache records on the internal DNS resolver, affected domains are resolving again.

csat.comment: Resolved, could have been a bit faster.
